svg.title: TIKIT 시스템 아키텍처
svg.desc: Basis: tmp.md -> image.png, docs/networkInfo.md, docs/FrontToBackSetting.md §8-1; backend/app/db/session.py and app/db/mongo.py. This is the documented deployment topology, not live infrastructure discovery. The older proposed seven-VM layout in docs/serverSpec.md is not used because it conflicts with supplied image/IP plan. Internal HTTP ports follow §8-1; optional internal TLS from §8-5 is not represented as deployed. Galera is taken from supplied image, not confirmed by tracked Galera configuration. DB/MongoDB/monitoring ports are conventional values to be checked against deployed configs. Physical PC allocation is not inferred for the expanded topology. Prometheus initiates metric scrape; Alloy pushes logs to Loki; Grafana queries both. HAProxy instances are shown as single endpoints; no VIP/VRRP or failover pair is claimed. Native draw.io graph has editable nodes and connected edges, without embedded screenshots.

g.text: 서비스 요청 경로 | 제공 구성도와 서버 IP표 기준 · 공통 대역 192.168.0.0/24
TLS 종료 · 정적 파일 · API 프록시
실선: 요청 전달 · .181 이후 내부 HTTP · API 주소 /api/v1/*
MariaDB: 업무 트랜잭션 · MongoDB: 분석용 행동 로그
